Existing operational metadata reset remains. Dialog and named success notice explain availability and the separate preparation choice. No new wizard, dependency or migration. Existing stored profiles are not modified.
change.decision: Boris and Nadia independently supported unavailable copies to honor R06. Challenged the alternative of retaining availability and revising wording to reduce steps. Both retained strict availability with existing direct Review room options; Nadia reserved that named next-step guidance was required. Final code reviews found no actionable blocker.
